prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["How Your Desktop Pet Lives", "Your pet wanders directly on your screen. Drag to move, right-click for quick actions, or double-click to play."]
1: ["Your Companion is Ready!", "Here are 3 quick actions to get started on your desktop:", "Right-click pet icon to access settings or hide pet", "Click and drag pet anywhere on your screen"]
2: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Bring life to your workspace with a digital pet tailored to your workflow.", "Choose Your Starting Path", "Select a ready-made companion or build your own from scratch."]
3: ["Upload Pet Photo", "Use a clear, front-facing photo with good lighting for best generation quality.", "Select Photo"]
4: ["Sign In to Restore Your Pets", "Signing in syncs your account cloud data and restores your saved companions.", "Use your primary email to re-connect your existing pet collection."]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet...", "We are generating your desktop graphics. This usually takes around 2 minutes."]
6: ["Preset pets spawn immediately without rendering wait time!", "Instant Desktop Drop"]
7: ["Setup Complete! Claim Your Starter Toy", "You unlocked an interactive pet toy item on your desktop for completing setup.", "Unlocked: Desk Ball Toy"]
8: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Pick a ready companion or build a custom desktop pet."]
9: ["Taking a moment to load? Check your connection or click retry below.", "Having trouble connecting? Ensure your browser or firewall allows authentication."]
